title: my-browser
description: A low-memory macOS web browser: a thin Rust shell over WebKit with sleeping tabs, built-in tracker and ad blocking, and Chrome extension support.

title: Edge Read Aloud
description: Chromium extension that reads any web page aloud with Microsoft Edge's neural voices, highlighting each word as it is spoken. 300+ voices, no API key.

title: arpmac
description: Rust TUI for macOS Internet Sharing: lists connected devices, shows per-client bandwidth, and blocks or unblocks clients with pf firewall rules.

title: Local LLM
description: Offline ChatGPT-style mobile app that downloads and runs LLMs like Gemma on-device, with image input, a model library, and chats stored in local SQLite.

title: Coderem
description: Flutter Android app that reminds you of upcoming Codeforces contests and shows your rating graph, submission stats and contest history.

title: UiBuild
description: Drag-and-drop website builder. Compose pages from blocks, style each element, preview at device widths, save versions and publish to a public URL.

title: G2000 Headset Landing Page
description: Mock product page for a gaming headset: a 3D model in a cube-mapped scene rotates, moves and scales with GSAP as you scroll through the sections.

title: Video / Audio Chat
description: Browser video calls and text chat for up to four people. Peers connect directly over WebRTC, and a small Socket.io server relays the signaling and chat messages.

title: RODE Solver
description: Chat-style solver for ODEs, derivatives and integrals: type math in a MathLive editor, get step-by-step Gemini solutions, save them and browse/vote on others'.

title: Open Hearts
description: Group chat app with markdown messages, voice notes, GIFs, replies, pinned messages, group admin tools and WebRTC video calls.

title: Musika
description: Browser music player: import local audio (ID3 tags read in-browser), build playlists stored in IndexedDB, stream songs from YouTube and fetch lyrics.

title: CrudMan
description: Browser-based REST API client like Postman: send requests with params, headers, body and auth, inspect responses, run tests, use environments and generate code.

title: Complete Portfolio Website
description: Single-page portfolio in plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript with animated sections, a filterable project grid, testimonial slider, Mapbox map and EmailJS contact form.
